description:
The sales clerks in a bank can use their software frontend to receive the credit-scoring for a certain customer. 
This starts a process in the banking system which communicates with the agency in the background. 
This process sends a scoring request to the agency right after the beginning. 
Then, the Agency does a first quick scoring (level 1). 
This will often lead to an immediate result which is then returned directly to the banking system within seconds. 
The banking process presents the result to the clerk sitting at the frontend. 
Sometimes the scoring cannot be determined immediately and takes longer. 
In this case the agency informs the banking process of the delay and then starts the level 2 scoring (which can take up to a couple of minutes). 
After the scoring result is determined, the information is sent back to the banking process. 
The banking process displays a message to the clerk when he receives information about the delay to check again later. 
As soon as the result arrives, it can be seen at the frontend.

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL"
                  xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance"
                  id="Definitions_CreditScoring"
                  targetNamespace="http://example.com/bpmn/credit-scoring">
  <bpmn:message id="Message_ScoringRequest" name="Scoring request"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_DelayNotice" name="Delay notice"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_ScoringResult" name="Scoring result"/>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_BankingSystem" name="Banking system credit-scoring" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:laneSet id="LaneSet_Banking">
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_BankingSystem" name="Banking system">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Start_CreditScoringRequested</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Send_ScoringRequest</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_WaitForAgency</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Catch_ImmediateResult</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Display_ImmediateResult</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>End_ImmediateResult</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Catch_DelayNotice</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Display_DelayNotice</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Catch_FinalResult</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Display_FinalResult</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>End_FinalResult</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
    </bpmn:laneSet>

    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_CreditScoringRequested" name="Clerk requests credit-scoring via frontend"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Send_ScoringRequest" name="Send scoring request" messageRef="Message_ScoringRequest"/>
    <bpmn:eventBasedGateway id="Gateway_WaitForAgency" name="Await agency response" eventGatewayType="Exclusive" instantiate="false"/>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Catch_ImmediateResult" name="Immediate scoring result received">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDef_ImmediateResult" messageRef="Message_ScoringResult"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:serviceTask id="Display_ImmediateResult" name="Present result to clerk at frontend"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_ImmediateResult" name="Result presented"/>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Catch_DelayNotice" name="Delay notice received">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDef_DelayNotice" messageRef="Message_DelayNotice"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:serviceTask id="Display_DelayNotice" name="Display message to check again later"/>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Catch_FinalResult" name="Scoring result received">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDef_FinalResult" messageRef="Message_ScoringResult"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:serviceTask id="Display_FinalResult" name="Present result to clerk at frontend"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_FinalResult" name="Result presented"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Bank_01" sourceRef="Start_CreditScoringRequested" targetRef="Send_ScoringRequest"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Bank_02" sourceRef="Send_ScoringRequest" targetRef="Gateway_WaitForAgency"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Bank_03" sourceRef="Gateway_WaitForAgency" targetRef="Catch_ImmediateResult"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Bank_04" sourceRef="Gateway_WaitForAgency" targetRef="Catch_DelayNotice"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Bank_05" sourceRef="Catch_ImmediateResult" targetRef="Display_ImmediateResult"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Bank_06" sourceRef="Display_ImmediateResult" targetRef="End_ImmediateResult"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Bank_07" sourceRef="Catch_DelayNotice" targetRef="Display_DelayNotice"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Bank_08" sourceRef="Display_DelayNotice" targetRef="Catch_FinalResult"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Bank_09" sourceRef="Catch_FinalResult" targetRef="Display_FinalResult"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Bank_10" sourceRef="Display_FinalResult" targetRef="End_FinalResult"/>
  </bpmn:process>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_Agency" name="Agency credit-scoring" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_ScoringRequest" name="Scoring request received">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDef_ScoringRequest" messageRef="Message_ScoringRequest"/>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_Level1Scoring" name="Perform level 1 scoring"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_ImmediateResult" name="Result determined immediately?"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Send_ImmediateResult" name="Send scoring result" messageRef="Message_ScoringResult"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Send_DelayNotice" name="Inform banking system of delay" messageRef="Message_DelayNotice"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_Level2Scoring" name="Perform level 2 scoring"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Send_FinalResult" name="Send scoring result" messageRef="Message_ScoringResult"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_MergeResults" name="Merge scoring outcomes"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_AgencyScoring" name="Scoring result sent"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Agency_01" sourceRef="Start_ScoringRequest" targetRef="Task_Level1Scoring"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Agency_02" sourceRef="Task_Level1Scoring" targetRef="Gateway_ImmediateResult"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Agency_03" name="Immediate result" sourceRef="Gateway_ImmediateResult" targetRef="Send_ImmediateResult">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">immediateResultAvailable</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Agency_04" name="Scoring takes longer" sourceRef="Gateway_ImmediateResult" targetRef="Send_DelayNotice">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">not immediateResultAvailable</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Agency_05" sourceRef="Send_ImmediateResult" targetRef="Gateway_MergeResults"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Agency_06" sourceRef="Send_DelayNotice" targetRef="Task_Level2Scoring"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Agency_07" sourceRef="Task_Level2Scoring" targetRef="Send_FinalResult"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Agency_08" sourceRef="Send_FinalResult" targetRef="Gateway_MergeResults"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Agency_09" sourceRef="Gateway_MergeResults" targetRef="End_AgencyScoring"/>
  </bpmn:process>

  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_CreditScoring" name="Credit-scoring collaboration">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_BankingSystem" name="Banking system" processRef="Process_BankingSystem"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Agency" name="Agency" processRef="Process_Agency"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_ScoringRequest" name="Scoring request" sourceRef="Send_ScoringRequest" targetRef="Start_ScoringRequest" messageRef="Message_ScoringRequest"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_DelayNotice" name="Delay notice" sourceRef="Send_DelayNotice" targetRef="Catch_DelayNotice" messageRef="Message_DelayNotice"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_ImmediateResult" name="Immediate scoring result" sourceRef="Send_ImmediateResult" targetRef="Catch_ImmediateResult" messageRef="Message_ScoringResult"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_FinalResult" name="Scoring result" sourceRef="Send_FinalResult" targetRef="Catch_FinalResult" messageRef="Message_ScoringResult"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>
</bpmn:definitions>
